_comment: Where the toy project's seed repository and its active run live, the public repository address used in the seed's run links, the plugin directories a run must not load when the global configuration loads the workflow from another checkout (empty when it loads this one, whose plugins a run then uses as loaded), the shared scratch directory a run may use, and the model with its variant (provider/model#variant) that toy/drive.py starts every session on. Copy this file to toy.json and fill every value. See toy/run.py.
